{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values in patient_id
missing_patient_id = data['patient_id'].isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patient_id = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Total number of unique patients
num_patients = data['patient_id'].nunique()

missing_patient_id, duplicate_patient_id, num_patients"}
